Keith Scandone featured on Daily Ad Brief

O3’s CEO and Co-Founder Keith Scandone spoke with Cindy Ashton on Daily Ad Brief recently. They dug into why CX is important and how brands can stand out in today’s climate.

Watch the interview for more tips on delivering positive customer experiences.
